subject: skill/stack/playwright
claim: The website SVG rendering gate uses Playwright's direct async API (async_playwright), launches Chromium itself, waits for document completion, then applies an explicit 700ms settle delay before probing rendered SVG. It captures full-page screenshots with page.screenshot(..., full_page=True). This repository does not currently use the pytest-playwright fixture model.
notes: Repo conformance edit: corrected the pytest-playwright fixture claim. The maintained rendering gate imports and drives async_playwright directly and intentionally uses a bounded settle delay before capture.
